reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V4 (understeer-gradient corrected KS yaw-rate with 3 Hz Butterworth LPF on delta_road, 80 ms lag, per-segment gyro-bias) using K_us per platform from out/results.json plus the predict equation in run_ladder.py.
notes: V4 prediction = psi_corr[t-4] + per-segment-bias, where psi_corr = (v/L)*tan(LPF3Hz(delta_road)) / (1 + K_us*v^2/L). K_us read from out/results.json (per-platform). First 4 samples of each segment dropped due to 80ms lag alignment (1796 samples). baseline_rmse_recomputed matches canonical V0 to <1e-9.
